verdicts.reason: A has a broken reading order: the 'See the Schedule' CTA sits at the very top, above the book and the headline. The '24 HOURS' eyebrow has dropped below the subcopy. The Inkwell & Lantern logo is shrunk to an illegible stamp in the bottom-left corner, the legal line floats on its own, and the card fills almost the whole canvas, so the terrazzo brand texture survives only as a strip along the bottom edge. B gets the hierarchy right (the headline leads, the CTA is large and grouped with its copy) and keeps the terrazzo as a left band, but the tiny logo sits directly on the busy confetti, which is a legibility collision. The eyebrow is also misplaced below the subcopy, the book awkwardly straddles the card edge, and the bottom-right is left as a large dead area.
